name: Grade 7 IIIT Practice: October Week 4 - Scratch Decomposition
description: Practice words for decomposition and subroutines.

words.definition: Breaking a big task into smaller parts.
words.example: Decomposition split the game into start, play, and finish parts.

words.definition: A smaller named part of a program that can be reused.
words.example: The jump subroutine was reused by two sprites.

words.definition: To run a subroutine from another part of a program.
words.example: The main program can call the dance subroutine.

words.definition: The main set of instructions that controls a project.
words.example: The main program controlled the order of the scenes.

words.definition: To use something again instead of rebuilding it.
words.example: Reuse saved time because the same blocks worked twice.

words.definition: A reusable repeat block used inside a decomposed Scratch task.
words.example: The loop repeated the animation until the song ended.
